output.content: The weekly retraining job pushes new model weights to the shared storage bucket every Sunday night. I note the training date and feature list in a local spreadsheet. When the morning order window opens, the serving container pulls the file from that bucket. I check the file timestamp against my notes on Tuesday mornings. If the timestamp is older than the last training run, I flag it for a manual redeploy. The storage bucket holds the current and previous three versions, but there is no index linking a specific prediction to the exact weights used to generate it.
